chunks: Mind yourself and consider for a while,
as though you had reached the end of life and had been buried under the earth.
Then your actions will be presented before you in the place where the oppressor cries “Alas” while he who wasted his life yearns for return (to the world),
but time was none to escape.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali mean by 'Fadhhi ruwaydan' in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) exhorts his officer to reflect on the brevity of life and the certainty of death, visualizing the moment when deeds are presented in the grave or on Judgment Day. It highlights the regret of the oppressor and the wasted soul, culminating in the Quranic verse that there will be no time for escape or reprieve. This admonition is characteristic of the *Khutbah al-Mutawakkiliyyah* context, where Ali addresses the administrative and spiritual accountability of those in power, emphasizing *muraqabah* (awareness of God) as a deterrent against tyranny.
